thread:
alex: Heads up — beta SI cohort C starts next week. Quick q about proctoring/credential flow: can we skip manual exam proctoring for partners who finish the lab and pass automated checks? @maria :wave:
maria: We talked briefly in triage — maybe. Need an audit trail + cert IDs. Chloe, do lab logs have enough signals for automated acceptance?
chloe: Logs currently include vm_run_time, browser_sysinfo, ip_geofence, and an optional video_check flag. We can add keystroke cadence and tab-switch events as heuristics. Could be sufficient for basic certs, but legal/enterprise customers may still want video. :thinking_face:
devon: For Dedicated SIs (paid/reserved) require video proctoring + ID check. For marketplace/SI self-onboarding do auto-checks + 2FA and a random live audit. Proposed flow below:
```yaml
proctoring_basic:
  tier: basic
  checks: [browser_check, keystroke_cadence, ip_geofence]
  cert_issue: auto
  audit_retention_days: 90

proctoring_enterprise:
  tier: enterprise
  checks: [video_proctor, id_verification, live_interview]
  cert_issue: manual_review
  audit_retention_days: 365
```
maria: Nice. Action items: 1) Chloe to add keystroke and tab-switch events to logs; 2) Devon to update cert issuance docs + marketplace UI flags; 3) Alex to sync legal on retention windows and video policy. I'll spin up a Confluence page with the flows and copy here. @onboard-bot can you create the checklist? :memo:
onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-1345 — "SI proctoring & credential checklist"
alex: Great, thanks. I'll review the Confluence draft before Friday's partner enablement runthrough. :thumbsup:
